en: the perfectly self-awakened one (sammāsambuddha), the privately awakened one (paccekasambuddha), the one liberated in both ways (ubhatobhāgavimutta), the one liberated by wisdom (paññāvimutta), the body-witness (kāyasakkhī), the one attained to view (diṭṭhippatto), the one liberated by faith (saddhāvimutta), the follower of Dhamma (dhammānusārī), and the follower of faith (saddhānusārī).
This is the group of nine.
